entries.complaint: Every brand, and sometimes each line within a brand, uses its own battery, so switching brands means buying new batteries and chargers
entries.redesign: A shared battery connector standard across brands, with each brand competing on the tool itself
entries.prior_art: Cordless Alliance System; Power X Change; Bosch Amp Share

entries.complaint: Nothing tells you the door was left open overnight, and built-in alerts are missing, fixed at an hour, or don't fire
entries.redesign: A light on the wall button that stays lit while the door is open, plus an opener setting that auto-closes after a set time or after dark

entries.complaint: Keypads and remotes stop working with no warning, usually a dead battery, lost pairing or lock mode, and each brand resets differently
entries.redesign: A low-battery blink on the keypad weeks ahead, and an opener light that shows when lock mode is on

entries.complaint: Thin 1/8-inch hooks wobble in 1/4-inch holes and fall out every time a tool is taken down
entries.redesign: Hooks with a twist-lock tab that snaps behind the board, sized to the hole, and sold in the same kit as the board
entries.prior_art: Locking pegboard hooks; steel pegboard systems

entries.complaint: Long cords twist and kink into a tangle when coiled, and the kinks damage the wire inside
entries.redesign: A flat cord that coils without twisting, with a built-in strap and a lit end that shows the cord is live
